question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

"A speech made without preparation ___."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Extempore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Extempore"** refers to speaking or performing without any prior preparation or rehearsal. (बिना पूर्व तैयारी के)

 
 
• **Example:** The student delivered an extempore speech on the topic of global warming and impressed everyone.
 

 
• **Extempore** is often used in the context of speeches, debates, or performances where spontaneity is required. (तत्काल भाषण)

 
 
• **Example:** She was asked to speak extempore at the event, and she did a fantastic job.
